in_marathi.name: Lallu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lallu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Lallu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lal' which means 'playful' or 'little'. This name is used in Hindu culture for both boys and girls, symbolizing the joy and innocence of childhood.
